producer_report.summary: OLY-B-S6-01 now has a mechanism: the committed ledger docs/critique-ledger.toml (four entries, covering all three kinds and including athena-subject entries), and a strict parser and standard check in crates/athena-core/src/critique_ledger.rs. The new test file crates/athena-core/tests/critique_ledger.rs parses the real ledger and the real spec entry, and checks each refusal on a mutated copy. The spec entry names the mechanism, owner Athena and a measure ending `status: not shown`. I also added the CHANGELOG entry, moved row S6-1 of the requirements map to Partial, and registered the test in xtask/shard-timings.txt. I did not run the full workspace `cargo test`.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S6-01 has mechanism naming the new module path under crates/athena-core/src/ and docs/critique-ledger.toml (no longer "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test command `cargo test -p athena-core --test critique_ledger`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml. Test spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism asserts mechanism, owner, measure_problem none, ending and test command; passes.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/critique-ledger.toml exists with [[entry]] tables covering all three kinds (critique, improvement, open_question), each with id, kind, subject, status, text and source, and at least one entry with subject athena (visible in the diff).
criteria_check.evidence: File created with 4 entries (C-001 athena, C-002, I-001 athena, Q-001 athena). Test the_real_ledger_parses_and_meets_the_standard passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The new module is registered in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs with a doc line, and the module parser rejects unknown keys, unknown kinds or statuses, blank text, and duplicate ids.
criteria_check.evidence: lib.rs has `pub mod critique_ledger;` and a doc bullet. Tests an_unknown_key_is_refused, a_bad_kind_is_refused, a_bad_status_is_refused, blank_text_is_refused, a_repeated_id_is_refused pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test critique_ledger`: it parses the real docs/critique-ledger.toml and the real docs/spec.toml entry and passes; the tests include negative cases (duplicate id, bad kind, no athena-subject entry, missing kind coverage) that fail validation, so the test fails if the ledger or its validator is removed.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran the command: 12 passed, including a_ledger_without_an_athena_entry_fails_the_standard and a_ledger_missing_a_kind_fails_the_standard.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` for the workspace, `cargo clippy` for the workspace and `cargo fmt --check`; each passes (or the same-tree recorded passing checks per D115).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran athena-core clippy (clean), fmt, policy and mirrors tests, all passing.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for this job; no existing entry of docs/decisions.md or anything under records/ is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: Entry added at the top of Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md; docs/decisions.md and records/ untouched.

A new test file needs a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt; the mirrors test enforces it.
